reason: The row holds more than fits and scrolls sideways, so WCAG 2.1.1 asks that a keyboard be able to reach and move it: the container is one tab stop carrying a group role and a name, and the arrow keys scroll it once focus lands. Nothing here moves on its own under either behaviour, since snap and flow both describe where a scroll SETTLES, so no pause control is owed under WCAG 2.2.2 and prefers-reduced-motion has nothing to answer.
